system_summary.pricing_formula_quote_path: (labor_hours * qty * MULTIPLY_HOURS_drivers) + drive_hours) * crew_rate + materials*(1+waste)*(1+markup)) * (1+overhead) * risk / (1-0.30)

PROPERTY_TYPE.question: What type of property is this?
